gloss: to repel; to oppose; to rebound

definitions.gloss: to oppose; to resist; to rebel against
definitions.explanation: To push back against an idea, authority, or pressure, often with strong feeling.

definitions.gloss: to repel; to bounce back; to rebound
definitions.explanation: For a physical object or force to push away from another, or for a market/price to recover after a decline.

examples.english: After stock prices fell sharply, they rebounded and recovered.

notes:
The two senses share the core idea of pushing back — either emotionally/socially (sense 1) or physically (sense 2). The noun form ⟦{反発|はんぱつ}→反発：08676_hanpatsu⟧ is very common, often used with ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧ (to receive pushback) or ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{招|まね}く→招く：02425_maneku⟧ (to invite opposition).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{反発|はんぱつ}→反発：08676_hanpatsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧: to invite opposition; to provoke backlash
- {反発力|はんぱつりょく}: repulsive force; resilience
- ⟦{反発|はんぱつ}→反発：08676_hanpatsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧: strong opposition/resistance
- ⟦{株価|かぶか}→株価：05154_kabuka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{反発|はんぱつ}→反発：08676_hanpatsu⟧: stock price rebound

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{反対|はんたい}する→反対する：05648_hantaisuru⟧: to oppose — more neutral and deliberate; ⟦{反発|はんぱつ}→反発：08676_hanpatsu⟧ implies stronger emotional pushback
- ⟦{抵抗|ていこう}する→抵抗する：15888_teikousuru⟧: to resist — focuses on sustained resistance rather than an immediate pushback
- ⟦{反抗|はんこう}する→反抗する：25385_hankousuru⟧: to defy; to rebel — stronger, implies defiance against authority
